TITLE: Glossary: account
DEFINITION: An account is a single registration held at Northwind Financial, such as an individual brokerage, joint, IRA, Roth IRA, or cash management account.

TITLE: Glossary: client
DEFINITION: A client is a person or entity that owns at least one account, and joint owners count as one client record each.

TITLE: Account opening handbook: what counts as active
DEFINITION: An active account is an account with status OPEN and a cash or securities balance greater than zero (a funded account), and login activity is not part of this definition.

TITLE: Glossary: funded account
DEFINITION: A funded account is an OPEN account with a balance greater than zero on the as-of date.

TITLE: Glossary: dormant account
DEFINITION: A dormant account is an OPEN account with no client-initiated activity (trade, transfer, or login) for 12 months or more.

TITLE: Glossary: household
DEFINITION: A household groups clients who share an address and an advisor relationship.

TITLE: Procedure: change a client address (current)
DEFINITION: To change a client address, verify identity with two-factor authentication in the service console, submit service request type ADDRESS_CHANGE with the new address, and the change takes effect within 1 business day, with a confirmation letter mailed to both the old and the new address.

TITLE: Procedure: beneficiary change
DEFINITION: To change a beneficiary on an IRA or transfer-on-death account, verify identity, collect the signed beneficiary form, and submit service request type BENEFICIARY_CHANGE, with a turnaround of 3 business days.

TITLE: Procedure: close an account
DEFINITION: To close an account: confirm a zero balance or a completed transfer out, submit service request type ACCOUNT_CLOSE, and record the closure reason code.

TITLE: Glossary: primary advisor
DEFINITION: The primary advisor is the advisor of record on the account, and each account has exactly one.

TITLE: Service metrics guide: active accounts
DEFINITION: An active account is an OPEN account whose owner has logged in within the last 90 days, regardless of balance.

TITLE: Glossary: engaged account
DEFINITION: An engaged account may be an OPEN account with a client login in the last 90 days.

TITLE: Glossary: service request
DEFINITION: A service request is a client or advisor request handled by Client Service, such as an address change, beneficiary change, transfer, statement copy, or account closure.

TITLE: Service level targets
DEFINITION: Service level targets are address change 1 business day, beneficiary change 3 business days, transfer 5 business days, statement copy 2 business days.

TITLE: Glossary: net new accounts
DEFINITION: Net new accounts for a period = accounts opened in the period minus accounts closed in the period.

TITLE: Glossary: average resolution time
DEFINITION: Resolution time is the number of calendar days from when a service request is opened to when it is closed, excluding open requests.

TITLE: Glossary: open service request
DEFINITION: An open service request has status OPEN or IN_PROGRESS.

TITLE: Glossary: advisor region
DEFINITION: Advisors belong to one of four regions: Northeast, Southeast, Central, or West.

TITLE: Procedure: change a client address (2019 version)
DEFINITION: To change a client address the client must send a signed letter by mail, and Operations keys the change after a medallion signature check, which takes 5 business days.

TITLE: Glossary: account type
DEFINITION: Account types: Individual Brokerage, Joint Brokerage, Traditional IRA, Roth IRA, Cash Management.

TITLE: Glossary: as-of date
DEFINITION: Unless stated otherwise, reported counts use the data as of 2026-11-15.

TITLE: Procedure: reopen a closed account
DEFINITION: A closed account can be reopened within 90 days of closure with a service request of type ACCOUNT_REOPEN.

TITLE: Glossary: client tenure
DEFINITION: Client tenure is the years since the client opened their first account.

TITLE: Glossary: average balance
DEFINITION: Average balance is the mean balance across funded accounts, excluding unfunded accounts.

TITLE: Procedure: statement copy
DEFINITION: Statement copies for the last 7 years are available in the client portal, while older statements need a service request of type STATEMENT_COPY.

TITLE: Procedure: transfer between accounts
DEFINITION: Transfers between accounts with the same owner can be submitted in the portal and settle the next business day.

TITLE: Glossary: channel
DEFINITION: Service requests arrive through one of three channels: Phone, Portal, or Branch.

TITLE: Glossary: advisor book
DEFINITION: An advisor book is the set of accounts where the advisor is the primary advisor.

TITLE: Data office FAQ: which definition wins?
DEFINITION: When two pages define the same term differently, the data product owner decides, the approved definition is published in the semantic view, and the other page is marked superseded.

TITLE: Procedure: login troubleshooting
DEFINITION: Clients reset portal passwords themselves, and locked accounts need a service request of type PASSWORD_RESET.
